value.syntax: # [doc = " A map whose entries stand in the bytewise-lexicographic order of their"] # [doc = " encoded keys, keys pairwise distinct."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `Clone`, `PartialEq`, and `Hash` are hand-written for the same reason as"] # [doc = " [`Value`]'s — a derived walk recurses to the nesting depth — and each"] # [doc = " delegates to the shared worklist helpers."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{Map, Value, ValueError};"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let m = Map::new(["] # [doc = "     (Value::Unsigned(3), Value::Unsigned(4)),"] # [doc = "     (Value::Unsigned(1), Value::Unsigned(2)),"] # [doc = " ])"] # [doc = " .expect(\"distinct keys\");"] # [doc = " assert_eq!(m.get(&Value::Unsigned(1)), Some(&Value::Unsigned(2)));"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let err = Map::new(["] # [doc = "     (Value::Null, Value::Unsigned(1)),"] # [doc = "     (Value::Null, Value::Unsigned(2)),"] # [doc = " ])"] # [doc = " .expect_err(\"the key repeats\");"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!(err, ValueError::DuplicateMapKey { index: 1 }));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug , Eq , Default)] pub struct Map (Vec < (Value , Value) >) ;
